description: Defines the FileStream class, an interface for asynchronous and synchronous file I/O operations including open, close, read, write, seek, get file info, and flush, with support for callbacks and managing underlying file resources.

classes.name: net::FileStream
classes.description: A class providing an interface for asynchronous and synchronous file read/write operations with support for seeking, opening, closing, and flushing.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a file asynchronously with specified flags, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the file asynchronously, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the file stream is currently open.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Adjusts the read/write position within the file asynchronously.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data asynchronously from the current position into a buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data asynchronously from a buffer to the current position.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Forces a filesystem sync on the file asynchronously.
